title: Fund With Anthropic Stake Extends Drop in Stunning IPO Reversal | Stock Market News
summary: Shares of the Fundrise Innovation Fund plummeted after a sharp decline, despite remaining high compared to the underlying value of its tech holdings. Other funds also experienced volatility amidst the trading frenzy for stakes in private tech companies.
sentiment_reason: The article describes a negative market impact characterized by a significant drop in share prices and volatility, influenced by short-selling and trading restrictions.
